profile_text: Specializing in commercial and residential property management in Düsseldorf, Germany, this real estate management company has experienced 50% growth since its baseline, driven by its expertise in managing properties in this key market. With a focus on providing comprehensive management services, the company has expanded its employee base to 18 in 2024, solidifying its position as a scaler in the industry. Its growth is a testament to the increasing demand for professional property management services in the region.
